reference_facts: sheet_name seleciona planilha; None retorna dicionário.

`read_excel` can read more than one sheet, by setting `sheet_name` to either\
a list of sheet names, a list of sheet positions, or `None` to read all sheets.\
Sheets can be specified by sheet index or sheet name, using an integer or string,\
respectively.\
\

`ExcelFile` can also be called with a `xlrd.book.Book` object\
as a parameter. This allows the user to control how the excel file is read.\
For example, sheets can be loaded on demand by calling `xlrd.open_workbook()`\
with `on_demand=True`.\
\
```\
import xlrd\
\
xlrd_book = xlrd.open_workbook("path_to_file.xls", on_demand=True)\
with pd.ExcelFile(xlrd_book) as xls:\
df1 = pd.read_excel(xls, "Sheet1")\
df2 = pd.read_excel(xls, "Sheet2")\
```\

interpretation.english_question: How to read a specific sheet from an Excel file?

claims.text: To read a specific sheet from an Excel file using pandas 2.2.3, specify the sheet name or index in the `sheet_name` parameter of `pd.read_excel()`.

evidence_quotes.quote:
pd.read_excel("path_to_file.xls", sheet_name=["Sheet1", 3])

`read_excel` can read more than one sheet, by setting `sheet_name` to either
a list of sheet names, a list of sheet positions, or `None` to read all sheets.
Sheets can be specified by sheet index or sheet name, using an integer or string, respectively.

claims.text: For multiple sheets, pass a list of sheet names or indices to `sheet_name` to read specific sheets.
